what_to_detect: A damage event dealt by a source with lifelink (as last known, even if the source has left the battlefield) paired with a life_change gain for its controller.
near_miss: A damage event dealt by a source with no lifelink, with no life gain for its controller.
record_fields: resolution payload damage_dealt (cause/source) and life_change events
snapshot or last-known keywords of the damage source

what_to_detect: A spell on the stack with lifelink dealing damage, paired with a life_change gain for its controller.
near_miss: A spell with no lifelink dealing the same damage, with no life gain for its controller.
record_fields: resolution payload damage_dealt (cause) and life_change events
granted keywords of the spell as a stack object
